hero.oneLiner: Healthcare logistics and workforce solutions provider offering home sample collection, phlebotomy staffing, cold-chain transportation, and technology-enabled support to diagnostic labs, hospitals, and healthcare companies across India.

one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: Healthcare logistics and workforce solutions provider offering home sample collection, phlebotomy staffing, cold-chain transportation, and technology-enabled support to diagnostic labs, hospitals, and healthcare companies across India.

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: Credent Connect N Care provides integrated logistics, workforce, and technology-enabled support services to diagnostic laboratories, IVD companies, pharmaceutical companies, clinics, and other healthcare enterprises in India. Core offerings include home sample collection via trained phlebotomists, stationed phlebotomy/lab-technician deployment, temperature-controlled inter-state and intra-state sample logistics, corporate wellness programs (C3 Wellness), and a courier aggregation platform (C3 Post). It operates through 2 warehouses and 4 branch offices, with a fleet of 97 owned commercial vehicles and 2,589 riders as of June 30, 2026.

group_structure.title: Group structure (subsidiaries / JV / related parties)
group_structure.body:
- Credent Healthcare Private Limited — Wholly owned subsidiary: Became material subsidiary Apr 2, 2025; wholly owned since Oct 8, 2025
- Credent Team Private Limited — Wholly owned subsidiary: Acquired Dec 26, 2025
- Alltrak Technologies Private Limited — Wholly owned subsidiary: Acquired Feb 26, 2026; technology platform development

products.title: Products & brands
products.body:
- **Logistic Services:** inter-state and intra-state healthcare logistics, temperature-controlled/TAT-sensitive sample transportation, C3 Post smart courier aggregation platform (pan-India, COD reconciliation, cold-chain)
- **Operations & Supply Chain Management:** stationed phlebotomy teams at laboratories and hospitals, deployment of skilled laboratory technicians and paramedical staff
- **HealthCare Services:** home sample collection via trained phlebotomists, end-to-end phlebotomy services at client locations, C3 Wellness corporate health camps, vaccination programs, and diagnostic screening (ECG, PFT, digital X-ray, dental, ENT, doctor-on-arrival)

end_markets.title: End Markets (RHP)
end_markets.body:
- Diagnostic laboratories
- In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) companies
- Pharmaceutical companies
- Clinics
- Hospitals
- Corporates/institutions (wellness programs)

certifications.title: Certs (RHP)
certifications.body:
- ISO 9001:2015 (financial management, strategic management, HR, marketing, operations & supply chain management)
- ISO 15189:2022 (medical laboratory and diagnostic imaging services)

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Service-based company with no significant plant & machinery requirement and no specific raw-material requirement. Subsidiary Credent Healthcare Private Limited owns limited diagnostic equipment (Cardiovit CS 20 treadmill, Versana Balance V2 USG, LG Wireless X-Ray Detector) used in service delivery. Technology backward-integration via wholly owned subsidiary Alltrak Technologies Private Limited's 'LogiTrak' SaaS platform (real-time sample tracking, GPS rider tracking, workforce management, geo-fencing) used internally for own operations. No technical or financial collaboration agreements or joint ventures entered into with third parties.

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Consolidated FY26 revenue (₹21,416.18 lakhs) and margin expansion (EBITDA margin 13.29% vs 6.41% FY25 standalone) driven largely by consolidation of Credent Healthcare Private Limited
- Revenue mix shift toward higher-margin HealthCare Services (43.04% of FY26 consolidated revenue) alongside Logistic Services (25.26%) and Operations & Supply Chain Management (27.67%)
- Customer concentration easing (Top 10 customers down to 81.76% of revenue in FY26 from 87.92% in FY24) while supplier concentration has risen sharply (Top 10 suppliers up to 46.97% in FY26 from 22.70% in FY24)
- Geographic revenue concentration in Maharashtra (29.40%) and Uttar Pradesh (26.83%) for FY26

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Continue investing in technological capabilities via subsidiary Alltrak Technologies to build a proprietary healthcare-logistics tech platform, including pay-per-use models for smaller healthcare players
- Deepen client engagement by expanding into warehousing/distribution and healthcare-specific long-distance logistics
- Expand into Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities targeting regional, standalone and smaller healthcare providers via pay-per-order/variable-cost engagement models
- Explore strategic mergers and acquisitions within the healthcare ecosystem to expand service offerings and geographic coverage (no specific targets identified as of RHP date)
- Attract, develop and retain skilled employees through recruitment, development and retention investment

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: No physical plant capex; growth is via inorganic expansion (three subsidiary acquisitions — Credent Healthcare, Credent Team, Alltrak Technologies — within the past year) and organic geographic/service expansion into Tier 2/3 cities, warehousing & distribution, and long-distance healthcare logistics, alongside continued technology-platform investment through Alltrak Technologies.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Comprehensive healthcare ecosystem and logistics platform spanning hospitals, clinics, diagnostic labs, IVD companies, and pharma, with cold-chain and multimodal transport
- Well-established, repeat client relationships (~280 domestic customers repeat business in FY26, incl. 38 customers for 3+ continuous years)
- Promoter/director experience: Chairman & MD (12 yrs) and WTD & CFO (9 yrs) in logistics industry
- Widespread domestic reach across Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Delhi, Karnataka, Haryana, Telangana and Rajasthan

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- High customer concentration — Top 10 customers contributed 81.76% of FY26 revenue with no firm commitments; loss of a major customer would be material
- Dependence on diagnostic/healthcare sector volumes — Revenue is directly linked to diagnostic testing volumes and outsourcing strategies of healthcare providers; fixed-cost operating model amplifies impact of volume decline
- Rising supplier concentration — Top 10 suppliers rose from 22.70% of purchases (FY24) to 46.97% (FY26), increasing vendor dependency
- Integration risk from recent acquisitions — Three subsidiaries (Credent Healthcare, Credent Team, Alltrak Technologies) acquired within the past 12 months; synergy realization and integration are unproven
- Geographic revenue concentration — Maharashtra and Uttar Pradesh together contributed ~56% of FY26 revenue
- FY26 KPIs are not like-for-like with FY25/FY24 — FY26 figures are consolidated (post-acquisition) while FY25/FY24 are standalone, inflating apparent growth and margin improvement

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Company intends to continue investing in and enhancing technological capabilities via wholly-owned subsidiary Alltrak Technologies to build a proprietary technology platform for healthcare logistics, including pay-per-use models for …**
- **Deepen engagement with existing clients by expanding into warehousing and distribution solutions and healthcare-specific long-distance logistics to create new revenue verticals**
- **Expand presence across Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities in India, targeting regional, standalone, and smaller healthcare providers via pay-per-order/variable-cost engagement models**
- **Explore strategic mergers and acquisitions within the healthcare ecosystem to enhance service offerings, expand geographic coverage, and achieve operational synergies; no specific acquisition targets identified as of RHP date**
- **Net Issue proceeds of ₹2,680.00 lakhs to be invested in wholly owned subsidiary Credent Healthcare Private Limited to meet its working capital requirement**
- **Net Issue proceeds of ₹300.00 lakhs to be invested in subsidiary Credent Healthcare Private Limited to finance capital expenditure requirements for machinery**
- **Net Issue proceeds of ₹3,700.00 lakhs to meet the Company's own working capital requirements**
- **Net Issue proceeds of ₹600.00 lakhs to be used for repayment/prepayment, in full or part, of borrowings availed by the Company**
- **Attract, develop and retain skilled employees by investing in recruitment, development, retention and a rewarding work culture**
